title: OpenCode hack exposes API keys amid AI distillation attacks
description: The open-source AI coding project OpenCode experienced a security breach that exposed API keys used by a small number of its users with external providers. The incident involves unauthorized access to sensitive credentials, potentially impacting the security of those external services. No detailed technical information or exploit methods have been disclosed. There is no indication of active exploitation in the wild or a vendor patch. The affected versions are not specified.
aiSummary: OpenCode, an open-source AI coding project, notified some users that their API keys for external providers were exposed due to a security breach. The breach specifically compromised API keys, which are sensitive credentials used to authenticate and authorize access to external services. No further technical details, such as the breach vector or scope, have been provided. There is no evidence of known exploits or active attacks leveraging this exposure at this time.
aiImpact: Exposure of API keys can lead to unauthorized access to external services linked to those keys, potentially resulting in data leakage, service misuse, or financial impact depending on the privileges of the keys. Since only a small number of users were affected and no active exploitation is reported, the immediate impact appears limited but could escalate if keys are abused.
